subject.title: fix(agents): honor models.providers auth mode pin in credential eligibility

question: Should a provider auth pin be accepted as a fail-closed constraint on contradictory automatically discovered credentials, even when that changes an existing setup from ambient fallback success to a clear missing-authentication error?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but choosing whether a declared pin overrides a formerly usable ambient fallback is an upgrade and product-contract decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed pin contract
options.body: Merge the patch so automatically discovered credentials cannot silently override an explicit provider auth mode.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback compatibility
options.body: Keep the former ambient fallback behavior and define a different explicit policy only if maintainers want strict routing to be opt-in.

recommendation.title: Accept the fail-closed pin contract
recommendation.body: Merge the patch so automatically discovered credentials cannot silently override an explicit provider auth mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows this contributor owns the proposed auth-policy boundary and its focused contract tests.
